snippet.title: Tekken 7 - Ganryu Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/tekken-7-ps4/

From restaurateur to sumo success, witness the great Ganryu in action when he comes to TEKKEN 7! 

Prepare to unlock this fighter by getting the #TEKKEN7 Season Pass 3!
